summary: Completed full backend + frontend regression. 23/23 backend pytest cases pass including AI insights (Claude Sonnet 4.5 returned valid JSON with all 8 required keys). Frontend: Login (split layout + hero), quick login pre-fill, dashboard (5 KPIs + sales trend chart + aging chart + priority list + AI recommendation + open tasks), sidebar nav (Customers/Sales/Accounts/Schemes/Reports/Route Map/Notifications/Admin), Customers list (30 rows), Customer 360 (profile + AI insight cards: Executive Summary/Credit Risk/Pay Behavior/Next Order Prediction/Recovery + tabs Invoices/Payments/Visits/Statement), Accounts (Overdue 33 / Partial 31 / Unpaid 38 + Daily Checklist + GST snapshot), Reports (Sales Trend + Aging + Brand Performance + Productivity), Admin (KPIs + Leaderboard + Zoho Sync card with 'Credentials Pending' label + Workforce users table + Add user button), Schemes, Notifications, Route Map (OSM iframe present), Theme toggle (light->dark works, html.dark class applied). Role guards: sales user gets 403 on /api/dashboard/admin, Admin/Accounts sidebar links hidden for sales role.

issues: Recharts emits transient width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial render before container measures — purely console warning, charts render correctly. Optional: add min-width/min-height to ResponsiveContainer to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large (~700+ lines) — could be split into routers (auth/customers/dashboards/reports) for maintainability but not blocking.
Zoho sync endpoint clearly returns mocked/stub success and UI labels 'Credentials Pending' — properly disclosed.
AI insights cached for 6h in db.ai_insights — first call ~5-10s, subsequent instant; works as designed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All seeded data present on first backend startup. AI insights endpoint hits Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations (first call ~5-10s then cached 6h). Default admin role from seed is 'super_admin' (not 'admin') — backend require_roles accepts both. Frontend uses axios withCredentials + Bearer token from localStorage fallback. Route /dashboard/admin allows super_admin/admin/manager (not sales/accounts). MVP fully functional and visually polished (Swiss/Neo-Tactical aesthetic, Signal Orange).
